title: Google says it is testing a new toggle inside its Search Console with some UK domain owners, letting them decide whether their sites appear in AI search results (Igor Bonifacic/Engadget)
summary: Igor Bonifacic / Engadget: Google says it is testing a new toggle inside its Search Console with some UK domain owners, letting them decide whether their sites appear in AI search results — The company says opting out won't impact placement in regular searches. — More than three years after it began rolling …
contentText:
Igor Bonifacic / Engadget :

Google says it is testing a new toggle inside its Search Console with some UK domain owners, letting them decide whether their sites appear in AI search results   —  The company says opting out won't impact placement in regular searches.  —  More than three years after it began rolling …
